data.title: Who Killed Santa? Christmas Murder Mystery Game || Holiday Murder Mystery Party Game Kit || Christmas Dinner Party Game || Office Whodunit
data.description:
Santa Claus was found dead in his office on the night of the North Pole Christmas party.
Amongst this crowd of festive chracters, one of you is the murderer. Mingle, ask questions and trust no one. The fate of Christmas depends upon it.

Who Killed Santa? is the perfect Christmas themed murder mystery guaranteed to be a hit at any Christmas party or event. Packed with everything you need in one easy to 'play and print' download. 

▼INFO
Setting: North Pole Christmas Eve Party
Players: 8-20
Genders: Mixed (10 Male, 10 Female)
Game Length: Between 1.5-2 Hours but can be flexible
Suitable for all ages

▼THIS GAME INCLUDES
• 20 Character Guides and Scripts
• 3 Rounds of Detailed Evidence 
• Host Guide
• Evidence Guide
• Question Menu
• Who Did It? Slips
• Reward Certificates
• Party Ideas & Tips Guide
• Printable Posters and Wine Lables

▼HOW TO PLAY
This game can be played by 8-20 players. In this Christmas Murder Mystery, the 'murder' is decided on the night so you can play multiple times with diffrent outcomes. 
Invite your guests and hand out one character guide to each guest so they can prepare for the event in advance. On the night, each guest will get a Character Script that they can use to answer the questions on the Question Menu in each of the 3 rounds.
Each round will have a new piece of evidence introduced that will lead the group closer to the killer. 
At the end of the game, each player can guess who they think is the killer and finally have the murderer revealed.

data.title: Christmas Murder Mystery Game | Game in an Envelope | Christmas Eve in Little Smithering | Escape Room-Style Puzzles
data.description:
CHRISTMAS EVE IN LITTLE SMITHERING: a festive murder mystery game in an envelope.

Christmas Eve, 1927. All is calm in the village of Little Smithering, as snowfall blankets the rooftops. Villagers are cosy at home, enjoying a brandy and mince pie by the fire.

Little do they know that they will soon discover a body lying in the village square…

_____________________

HOW TO PLAY 

Christmas Eve in Little Smithering is a murder mystery puzzle game that's perfect for a cosy night in, solving crimes. Step back in time as you unseal the red envelope to reveal clues from a detective's case file…

STEP INTO THE STORY – Discover the world of Little Smithering and experience a Christmas Eve of carols, mulled wine, and murder. You'll need to uncover the facts of the case, including the victim, motive and murderer.

EXPLORE THE CLUES – Travel back to 1927 through each vintage item, such as a festive recipe, carol music, and a cracker joke.

SOLVE THE MYSTERY – Test your wits with escape-room-style puzzles, codes and hidden clues. Delve into the characters and story as you make your final deductions…

_____________________

HANDY INFO 

Number of players: 1–6
Difficulty: 3 out of 5
Ages: 14+
Time to play: 40–60 minutes, an ideal after-dinner game.

Don't be shy about using the hints! They will help guide you through the game. There are several layers of hints, so you can get help without giving the game away.

You will need a pencil and an internet connection, though most of the game is screen-free.

Envelope size: C5 (16cm x 23cm), not inclusive of outer packaging. Materials include paper and card. The kit is mostly recyclable.

For US customers: please note that the shipping costs include US government tariffs.

Designed in London. Assembled by hand in the UK.

_____________________

ABOUT US 
We are a London-based couple who love murder mysteries and treasure hunts. During lockdown, we realised play-at-home murder mysteries are a thrilling way to spend an evening, and we were inspired to create our own stories. 

We love sharing unique, handmade games, with satisfying puzzles to test your sleuthing skills.

This light-hearted Christmas themed murder mystery party game is an evidence-based, multiple murder mingling game for 8-20 players. 

Baby all I want for Christmas is you - to catch the killer red-nosed in this Xmas themed North Pole murder mystery! 

Welcome to Murder in a Winter Wonderland!

At Santa’s annual pre-flight party, elves, reindeer, and a whole host of Christmas characters gather to eat, drink, and be merry, not realising there is a cold-blooded killer among them!

Santa is found dead, but who could have committed this terrible yet suitably festive crime? Watch out as events are sure to snowball! Put on your thinking Santa hats, get into the Christmas spirits, and prepare to have this nightmare before Christmas wrapped up neatly in a bow!

This game is perfect for a house party game with friends, an extended family Christmas party, or really any group looking to enjoy a festive and punny night in this winter!

There will be more murders, madness and mayhem as the game progresses, with a game of truth or dare, characters disturbing the peace, and plenty of evidence to help you wrap this all up in this role playing murder mystery game.


Murder Mystery Kit Contents:

-Host guide
-How to play guide
-Character overview
-Character sheets for 8 core characters
-Character sheets for 12 expansion characters
-9 pieces of evidence to go through
-A Spotify playlist we think will help set the atmosphere for your party:

https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1Z74em1vWmdMF6KXbPPmnO?si=b90f6abd27ca48b3

-Loads of fun extras from personalised Murder Mystery Invitations and cocktail recipes!

Sisters Grimm was created and is still run entirely by two British sisters with a love of mysteries who want to bring a real sense of fun and even silliness to many of our murder games. We are independent and all about supporting small local businesses and women all over the world. If you like getting dressed up, hanging out with your family and friends and solving a crime at the same time then a Sisters Grimm game may well be the right choice for you.

Remember, all our games are digital downloads eliminating the need for lots of paper and avoiding any postal delays – you will receive your game instantly when you click buy. Check out our FAQs and About Us sections and feel free to contact us with any questions as you try and find out who dunnit!


Remember our characters can be played by anyone you want, we encourage you to have fun with it, don't be afraid to mix things up and enjoy your party!

Rating - Be aware we do write these Murder Mystery games with adults in mind! It is in no way an 18+, but be prepared for double-entendres, murder and worst of all, puns!

So check out what we have so far and remember to watch this space as we are constantly writing and bringing you new and exciting adventures… and deaths!

Yours Spookily,

Naomi and Tamara

Sisters Grimm

data.title: Murder at the Manor - Murder Mystery Party Game, Host Plays, 16-25 players, No Acting, Large Group, Family Friendly, Repeatable, Halloween
data.description:
Halloween is coming quickly, are you ready? Make planning the perfect Halloween or fall party easy with our murder mystery kit!

The once-elegant Hawthorne Manor, a place of grandeur and whispered secrets, is now the scene of a chilling mystery. Just one week ago, a gathering of distinguished guests celebrated an unforgettable evening in the very same halls. But something went horribly wrong that night, something that only now is coming to light.

The victim: Reginald Carrington, a wealthy and well-connected business tycoon, was killed in the manor shortly after the guests departed. His body, however, was only discovered today—moved and concealed in one of the manor’s many rooms. The police are baffled. They can’t figure out where the murder truly took place, or with what weapon, and most troubling of all, they have no idea who is responsible.

This is where you come in. The authorities are asking for your help in solving this cold case. As you and your fellow guests return to the manor, you must uncover the truth behind Reginald’s murder. What weapon was used? Where was the crime actually committed? And, most importantly, who did it?

As the night goes on, you and your fellow guests will explore the manor, competing in mini challenges to uncover crucial clues about what happened. The more clues you can win, the greater advantage you'll have in solving the mystery. When all the clues have been discovered, you’ll begin making suggestions of what you think happened, gleaning information from others as you go. While suggestions are important to gather intel, the police view making an accusation as a serious matter. Before you can formally accuse anyone, you must prove yourself. If you succeed, they will take your accusation seriously. But beware—if your accusation turns out to be wrong, the police will no longer entertain your claims, and you will lose your chance to solve the case.

Be the first to correctly accuse the murderer, and you will bring justice to Reginald Carrington. But the clock is ticking, and the truth is waiting to be uncovered. Will you solve the mystery before it slips away forever?
...............................................................................
Step into a Murder Mystery Experience Like No Other With Our Murder at the Manor Party Kit

Murder at the Manor brings  classic mystery deduction board games to life with an exciting, competitive twist!

No acting skills required, and yes—the host gets to play too without knowing the solution! You and your guests will “explore” the manor, room by room, with each location triggering a mini-game. Compete against guests in a variety of fun activities, challenging different skills and abilities. Winning these games earns you cards to help you get closer to solving who, what, and where. The more cards you collect, the better your chances of solving the mystery when the deduction and accusation rounds begin.

If you think you've figured it out, you’ll need to prove yourself a worthy detective to the police before you can even make an accusation. Get it right and you've won the game. But beware—accusing the wrong suspect comes with consequences. 
.............................................................
What’s Included?

Our easy-to-follow kit includes everything you need to set up your own game. It’s home printer-friendly (yes, even if you just want black and white!) and designed with simplicity in mind. Any additional items are common household supplies, listed clearly in the instructions. Within our kit you'll receive:

- 75 Double-sided Game Cards
- Supplies List
- Set Up & Game Play Instructions
- Murder Mystery Introduction
- 27 Mini Games/Challenges with instructions and basic materials for each (25 are games triggered by "exploring" a room in the manor, the other two are the accusation challenges)
- Quick Play Instructions
- Explore the Manor Tracker (helps you keep track of which rooms have been picked and who has had a turn picking)
- Solution Trackers for all players to keep a record of what they know 
- 3 Different Invitation Styles for you to choose from!
- Each Invitation Style Also Comes With 25 Unique Character Cards (if you'd like everyone assigned a character, all work as male/female)
.................................................................
Who Can Play?

Ideal for teens and adults, but family-friendly for all ages. Our murder mystery is perfect for any occasion and all types of guests. Enjoy playing it for birthday parties, bachelorette parties, bachelor parties, adult party, family parties, family reunions, for Halloween, or just as a regular party game.  This kit is good for 16 players, 17 players, 18 players, 19 players, 20 players, 21 players, 22 players, 23 players, 24 players, or 25 players. Need a smaller one? Check out the same game in our other sizes in our store (6-12 players and 12-16 players).
............................................................
Is it Repeatable?

Yes! Unlike most murder mystery party games that are one and done, you can play our game again and again! Each time, there will be a new solution. You can even switch up the rooms you pick to trigger new mini games or just replay your favorites!
.................................................................
What sets our game apart from other murder mystery party kits?

- Keep everyone equally involved! Most murder mystery party's often result in a few bold personalities taking over and solving most of the challenges and mysteries while the rest of the guests watch on barely participating. In ours, every guest - no matter their personality type or interests - will be actively involved throughout the whole evening! 
- We specifically designed the mini-games and challenges to play to a large variety of strengths and talents so everyone has a chance to shine and to keep things fun and interesting. Some will leave you all laughing, others heart racing, some mentally scratching. There's a little bit of everything!
- All characters can work as male/female. We purposely chose generic names for all our characters so that they work for all your guests! No need to worry about if the male/female count in your party matches ours, simply assign out the characters however you would like!
- Easily adjust how long you want the murder mystery party to last! The normal play lasts about 2-4 hours, but we include instructions for a quick play version if you want it to only last about an hour.
- No acting needed, although if you'd like to decorate to set the scene and have everyone dress up, you can!
- Guests actually compete against each other to be the first to solve it instead of working all together
- Simple and cheap setup - only common household items needed 
- Over 25 mini party games that you can play on their own
- Home Printer friendly 
- Repeatable, get the most out of your money by replaying the game as many times as you'd like!
- Host plays, no need to sit on the sidelines conducting the mystery for your guests - enjoy playing it yourself!
- It is family-friendly, teen-friendly, etc. No worries about inappropriate content for those who may be younger, while still having a fun, thrilling, and exciting murder mystery party if it is all adults!
..............................................................
How do you set up our murder mystery party?

1) Read through our materials to familiarize yourself with how it all works
2) Follow instructions and recommendations to print out the materials you need
3) Cut out any needed materials and gather common household materials needed
4) Send out invitations - assign specific characters and invite people to dress up if you'd like!
5) Decorate if you'd like to set the scene
6) Party and have fun!
...................................................................
Why is this a great party option?

Whether you are planning a bachelorette party, a halloween party, a family party, a big friend party, work party, or anything else we provide a unique and complete experience wrapped in one. You have many options to easily customize to the length of your party, group size, etc. Our murder mystery also keeps everyone - no matter their personality - equally involved and engaged. We create an experience that will challenge people's skills but is also tons of fun and will create lots of laughs! Make it as low-key or immersed as you'd like and fits your group. With no need for acting, everyone feels way more comfortable and it avoids any awkwardness. So buy our kit today and see for yourself what a great party it can create!
.............................................................................
What does family-friendly mean?

No drugs, drinking, sex, adultery, immorality, innuendo, or inappropiiate games of any kind. No gory details or scary descriptions of the murder is described, it simply states in the introduction that the victim was found dead.
...................................................................................
Have questions, feedback, or suggestions? We’d love to hear from you.

We hope you enjoy the mystery party!l
